BiblicalUsage: Shapham stood second to Joel among the Gadites in Bashan, and the verse names him beside Jaanai and Shaphat. Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, is the whole of his record, and it places him among the heads of Gad.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the second man in Bashan mattered as much as the chief, because God kept his name beside Joel's.
